profile.name: AG-UC2 双轴压电步进控制器
profile.description: 用于驱动 Newport Agilis 系列两轴压电步进位移台或微定位器的运动控制器。设备可控制 X/Y 两个轴，支持相对移动、连续点动、限位搜索和状态查询，常用于光学对准、精密位移和微定位实验。
profile.description_en: A motion controller for Newport Agilis two-axis piezo stepper stages or micropositioners. It controls X and Y axes and supports relative motion, continuous jogging, limit seeking, and status monitoring, making it suitable for optical alignment, precision positioning, and micromanipulation experiments.
